items.title: Is the AI boom hiding a jobs crisis for graduates?
items.summary: Entrepreneur, bestselling author, and former presidential candidate Andrew Yang and former Salesforce AI CEO Clara Shih join Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa to examine the challenging job market facing recent college graduates. They discuss whether the massive AI infrastructure boom is masking broader labor market weakness and what the rise of artificial intelligence could mean for the next generation of workers.
